customManagers.description: Track the rokucommunity/vscode-brightscript-language release whose TextMate grammar we vendor in dev-docs/src/syntaxes/. When Renovate bumps the ref, the sync-brightscript-grammar workflow re-fetches the JSON so the PR contains both changes atomically.

Track the pinned shared-ui release that shared/fetch-shared-ui.mjs clones at build time. It follows the org preset like any dependency: patch and minor automerge after their soak once CI is green; majors wait for review.

packageRules.description: Label vendored-grammar bumps so they're easy to spot in the queue; do not automerge — humans review the upstream release notes before adopting.
